item.title: Quad9 从法国撤走了其 DNS 服务
item.description:
Quad9 Service Deactivation in France

Quad9 在法国停止服务

(en français)
（法文）

Today, November 24 2026, Quad9 will disable services for French users. This means any query reaching any Quad9 service address will be refused, and no DNS resolution will be successful. Our planned deactivation will be at 09:00 Central European (Paris) Time, to try to give users who are unaware a chance to respond quickly instead of having services down outside of normal business hours.
item.content:encoded:
from: A public and free DNS service for a better security and privacy

Quad9 Service Deactivation in France

Quad9 在法国停止服务

(en français)
（法文）

Today, November 24 2026, Quad9 will disable services for French users. This means any query reaching any Quad9 service address will be refused, and no DNS resolution will be successful. Our planned deactivation will be at 09:00 Central European (Paris) Time, to try to give users who are unaware a chance to respond quickly instead of having services down outside of normal business hours.

今天，2026 年 11 月 24 日，Quad9 将停用 French 用户的服务。这意味着任何到达任何 Quad9 服务地址的查询都将被拒绝， 且无法成功解析 DNS。我们的计划在 09:00 Central European (Paris) Time 进行停用，以便让 unaware 用户有机会快速响应，而不是在非工作时间服务不可用。

We are unhappy to have reached this impasse. For those of you seeing this for the first time, see our announcement of this deactivation from one month ago.

我们对陷入这样的僵局感到遗憾。对于第一次看到这条消息的人，请查看我们一个月前发布的关于此次停用的公告。

The Summary

摘要

We have received demands from beIn (a sports rightsholder company) to block various domains they claim to be related to piracy streaming sites, so users in France cannot resolve those DNS names. Currently, the courts have upheld beIn’s demands, and we have faced fines for non-compliance. We are entirely opposed to piracy, but Quad9 has nothing to do with the piracy sites. This is an attempt to force us to be part of an enforcement regime against third parties.

我们已收到 beIn (a sports rightsholder company) 的要求，要求其屏蔽各种与他们声称相关的盗版流媒体网站的域名，因此法国的用户无法解析这些 DNS 名称。目前，法院已支持 beIn 的要求，我们因此面临了非合规处罚。我们完全反对盗版，但 Quad9 与这些盗版网站无关。这是一种试图迫使我们将自己置于针对第三方的执法制度之中的做法。

We have a fundamental opposition to using recursive DNS providers as a tool in this or any other content blocking campaign. Putting demands on recursive resolvers has no effect on the origin servers that deliver objectionable content. Attacking recursive resolvers is a futile and counter-productive effort, but that explanation is not understood. The policymakers and courts of France may of course make any determination they wish, even those that seem ineffective or damaging in our view. We wish to remain within legal requirements where it is necessary. We have our own strict views of what we do and what services we deliver. Because there is a mismatch between the case outcome and our mission, we must withdraw from France to remain in compliance with both law and our internal guidelines.

我们基本反对使用递归域名系统提供者作为本次或任何其他内容屏蔽活动的工具。对递归解析器的要求对源服务器无效，源服务器交付不良内容。攻击递归解析器是一个徒劳且counter-productive effort，然而这种解释并不被理解。政策制定者和法院可以随意做出任何决定，即便在我们看来似乎无效或有害。我们在必要时遵守法律要求。我们对自己的所作所为和提供的服务有着严格的看法。由于案件结果与我们的使命不匹配，我们必须撤出法国，以同时遵守法律和我们的内部指南。

This is a terrible outcome, but it imposes the least amount of harm viewed over time longer than the duration of this case. We understand this will cause harm in the short term: users who do not know of our withdrawal will find our services unexpectedly unavailable. Users who have to move to different resolvers will not be protected by our cybersecurity capabilities, and they may choose to use resolvers that are less privacy-focused than Quad9.

这是一个糟糕的结果，但它在长期内造成的伤害最小，超出了本案的持续时间。我们理解这将在短期内造成伤害：用户若不知我们的撤销，将会发现我们的服务意外不可用，用户若需迁移至不同解析器，将失去我们的网络安全保护，可能会选择隐私性不如 Quad9 的解析器。

Repeating the Obvious

重申显而易见的道理

We object to the core premise of the legal arguments, which is the false assertion that recursive DNS can or should be used as a method to prevent piracy or any other type of content access. Our position is this is not effective or useful, as we have no monopoly on recursive DNS, and anyone can set up their own resolver in just a few seconds (though without the privacy and malicious content protection that Quad9 offers). The courts and plaintiff have not considered this argument and ignore it entirely in the judgement. Their interest is focused on the possibility for us to do what is demanded, even if it has results outside of France, and their interest is not in why that is unjust or unwise or ineffective. So, we will continue to argue with a refutation of our ability to do this accurately without applying French law to all other European nations and the world.

我们反对法律论证的核心前提，该前提是错误的主张，即递归 DNS 可以或应该被用作防止盗版或其他任何内容访问的手段。我们的立场是这并不有效或有用，因为我们不对递归 DNS 拥有垄断权，任何人都可以在几秒钟内设置自己的解析器（尽管缺乏 Quad9 提供的隐私和恶意内容保护）。法院和原告没有考虑这一论证，并在判决中完全忽视它。他们的关注点在于我们能否完成所要求的内容，即使它会产生法国以外的结果，他们的关注点并不在于此为何不公正、不智或无效。因此，我们将继续以对我们能够准确完成此任务而无需将法国法律适用于其他所有欧洲国家和全世界的能力进行反驳。

How Our Withdrawal Will Work

我们的提现将如何进行

There is an understandable focus on how Quad9 is going to block “French users” when we do not collect user information and have also claimed that geoIP blocking is insufficient for selectively denying resolution for certain names. We understand this seemingly apparent paradox, so we will expand on it as it is a question that is frequently repeated.

有一种容易产生的关注点，即 Quad9 将如何在我们不收集用户信息的情况下阻断 “French users”，并且我们还声称 geoIP 拦截不足以针对特定名称进行选择性拒绝解析。
我们理解这似乎是一个明显的悖论，因此我们将进一步阐述它，因为这个问题经常被反复提出。

Our geoIP-based method to identify and deny service to French users is inexact. We are aware that our methods to geographically locate users and declare they are in France is quite imprecise - this is inevitable. By using these methods, we will create conditions of overblocking, where we accidentally classify some queries as being from France when they are not from France, and it will also result in conditions of underblocking, where we do not correctly identify some queries as being from France and inappropriately complete those requests even though the user is in French jurisdiction. This imprecision is a core component of our case: there is no legally accurate way for us to determine what queries are from users located in France versus what queries are from users not in France. But we have no other mechanism - it simply does not exist.

我们基于 geoIP 识别并拒绝向法国用户提供服务的方法并不精确。我们清楚，我们用于对用户进行地理定位并判定其位于法国的方法相当不精确——这是不可避免的。使用这些方法会造成过度屏蔽（overblocking）的情况：我们会误将某些查询归类为来自法国，而它们实际上并非来自法国；这也会造成屏蔽不足（underblocking）的情况：我们未能正确识别某些查询来自法国，并在用户处于法国司法管辖区时不适当地完成这些请求。这种不精确性是我们论点的核心组成部分：我们无法以法律上准确的方式确定哪些查询来自位于法国的用户，哪些查询来自不在法国的用户。但我们没有其他机制——它根本不存在。

These geoIP lists are inaccurate in two dimensions: firstly, IP geolocation data are often imprecise or just plain wrong, as IP geolocation is not an exact science. Mobile operators span national boundaries, corporate WANs split networks across nations, IP addresses are bought and sold frequently, and network operators shift allocations across borders. These are just a few of many other examples of how geoIP association may not be accurate. Secondly, IP location does not necessarily equate to user location, geoIP data only is a guess as to the location of the IP address, not the location of the end user. VPNs may exit in France but have the majority of their users in other nations; corporate users in one nation may egress in another due to proxies or internal DNS service distribution - there is nothing about a query that has any indication of the jurisdiction of the origin of the query itself.

这些 geoIP 列表在两个维度上都不准确：首先，IP 地理位置数据通常不精确，甚至完全错误，因为 IP 地理定位并非一门精确的科学。移动运营商跨越国界，企业 WAN 将网络分布在多个国家，IP 地址频繁买卖，网络运营商跨国调整分配。这些只是 geoIP 关联可能不准确的众多示例中的一小部分。其次，IP 位置不一定等同于用户位置，geoIP 数据仅仅是对 IP 地址位置的推测，而非终端用户的位置。VPN 可能在法国出口，但其大多数用户可能在其他国家；一国的企业用户可能因代理或内部 DNS 服务分发而在另一国出口 —— 查询本身没有任何特征能指示查询来源的司法管辖区。

The data is imprecise, but we do not know to what level it is imprecise. So we must work with what we have.

数据并不精确，但我们不知道其不精确的程度。因此，我们只能基于现有数据进行工作。

Why Not Block With This Method?

为什么不用这种方法进行 Block？

We could apply this same geoIP filter database to selectively block French users from reaching the sites we have been told to make unavailable, but this would corrupt our core premise which is that the DNS is not the right mechanism for this blocking to happen. If we comply within France to meet the requirement then we accept the worst eventual outcome for users - we lose our integrity and still do not have legally perfect coverage, plus we will inevitably apply French rulings across borders into other nations. We wish to first remain consistent with our core mission which is to only block cyber risks to end users and not content. Secondarily, we must remain as close to compliance as we can to the legal constraints put upon us.

我们可以将这个相同的 geoIP 过滤器数据库用于有选择地阻止法国用户访问我们被告知需要让其不可用的网站，但这样做会破坏我们的核心前提，即 DNS 并不是用于实现这种阻止的合适机制。如果我们遵守法国的要求，那么我们就接受了用户最坏的最终结果——我们会失去完整性，并且仍然无法获得在法律上完全覆盖，此外我们还不可避免会把法国的裁决跨境应用到其他国家。我们希望首先与我们的核心任务保持一致，即仅阻止面向最终用户的网络风险，而非内容。其次，我们必须尽可能接近遵守我们被施加的法律约束。

By accepting even the smallest of the demands for blocking based on geoIP data, we would admit that such demands are permissible within our mission - that we accept to play a complicit role in aiding companies (or others) to create ineffective and mis-directed regimes of content constraint. We would be admitting that DNS blocking is a valid instrument for the piracy problem - it is not. We would be admitting we will do this for an ever-increasing number of names - we will not. We would be permitting these methods to be applied for more areas of content filtering such as moral, religious, social, or political reasons - we must not.

通过接受即使是基于地理位置信息（ geoIP ）数据的最小阻断要求之一，我们承认此类要求在我们的使命中是可接受的——我们接受扮演协助公司（或其他方）制造无效且误导性的内容限制机制的配合角色。 我们承认 DNS 阻断是应对盗版问题的有效手段——它不是。 我们承认我们将继续这样做，对越来越多的名称——我们不会。 我们允许这些方法被用于更多内容过滤领域，如道德、宗教、社会或政治原因——我们绝不能。

So we accept there will be egregious overblocking/underblocking errors in our blockade of French users but would rather remain steadfast to our stated mission and principles to uphold the integrity of the DNS. We would rather there be a clear distinction made for users of our services: you receive the DNS as you (the user) expect, or if Quad9 is forced to pollute the service with unexpected and arbitrary number of fragmentation demands, then we will not offer the services at all.

因此，我们接受在对法国用户实施封锁时会出现严重的过度封锁/封锁不足错误，但宁愿坚定奉行我们既定的使命和原则，以维护 DNS 的完整性。我们宁愿为使用我们服务的用户划清明确的界限：要么您获得的是您（用户）所期望的 DNS；要么，如果 Quad9 被迫以数量不可预期且任意的分片请求来污染服务，那么我们宁愿完全不提供该服务。

Doesn’t Quad9 Already Block Names?

Quad9 是否已经阻塞名称？

Quad9 blocks a set of cyber-threats on 9.9.9.9 (and secondary IPs) for end users, where the outcome would be an unexpected and harmful result to the end user (i.e., malicious software). Content blocking is explicitly not in that set. Quad9 has subjective editing on that set, as well - if we believe something is inappropriately categorized by our threat intelligence partners, then we can remove it at our discretion. Additionally, Quad9 also offers 9.9.9.10, which has no blocking of any kind - it is entirely open. The demands we have been given would enforce mandatory restrictions on all our service addresses, which then makes our statements of their functionality inconsistent with the reality that would be forced upon us. We will not accept that condition.

Quad9 对该集合也有主观编辑 - 如果我们认为我们的威胁情报合作伙伴对某事物进行了不恰当的分类，则我们可以自行决定将其移除。 此外，Quad9 还提供 9.9.9.10，其不阻止任何类型的内容 - 完全开放。 我们所受的要求将强制在 * 所有我们的服务 * 地址上实施强制性限制，这使得我们关于其功能的陈述与被强加的现实不一致。 我们不接受该条件。

The Future Prospects

未来前景

We take a long range and principled view to the outcome of this case and the others in line. There are unmistakable long-term risks to Quad9, to user privacy, and to potential fragmentation of the internet that are far beyond the current moment. To give in now would start ‘the beginning of the end’ and allow motion towards internet fragmentation that cannot be undone. We accept the risks and the pain that come with fighting where others in similar circumstances to ourselves must bend and compromise in this invisible card game where end users are not even at the table. We represent those users, and our nonprofit mission of public service is aptly unique by not representing any shareholders, products, or other interests other than the end user.

我们对本案及后续案件的结果持长远且原则性的立场。Quad9、用户隐私以及互联网碎片化面临显而易见的长期风险，其影响远超当下。此刻若选择妥协，将开启“终结的开端”，导致无法逆转的互联网碎片化进程。我们甘愿承担抗争带来的风险与代价，因为在处境相似的其他方不得不低头妥协的这场无形牌局中，终端用户甚至未获一席之地。我们代表这些用户，我们的非营利公共服务使命显得格外独特——我们不代表任何股东、产品，亦不代表除终端用户之外的任何其他利益。

It is especially disturbing to us to be doing this for an issue (piracy) which we believe is not slowed at all by any involvement of recursive DNS, though the damage to the integrity and trust of the global namespace is significant.

尤其令我们感到不安的是，我们这样做是为了一个我们认为 recursive DNS 无论如何介入都丝毫不会使其放缓的问题（盗版），而对全球 namespace 的完整性与信任所造成的损害却是巨大的。

We have seen recent articles about extended blocking demands given to ISPs in France of social media or instant messaging sites, which we anticipate would be demanded of us as well if continued. It is quite clear to us the path that is being taken with these efforts: first create the mechanism, then expand the volumes of the mechanism (unconstrained rightsholder editing of the DNS), then expand the scope of prohibitions to other groups and for other reasons until there is effectively no limit to the number of editors or the reasons for DNS names to be deleted from recursive resolution. This contradicts our mission of delivery of trustworthy DNS results, and we believe this potential outcome to be antithetical to a free and open internet.

我们已经看到 recent articles 关于 France 向互联网服务提供商 提供的社交媒体 或即时通讯 网站 的扩展封锁要求，我们预计如果持续下去，这些也将会成为对我们的要求。这对我们来说很清楚了，这些努力正在采取的路径是：首先创建机制，然后扩大机制的规模（对 DNS 无约束的权利持有人编辑），然后扩大禁止的范围到其他群体和其他原因，直到对递归解析中 DNS 名称被删除的编辑数量或原因没有了实际的限制。这与我们交付可信 DNS 结果的使命相矛盾，我们认为这个潜在结果与自由开放的互联网相悖。

This is the second legal assault we have faced to see if the DNS can be slowly corrupted - we stood our ground and eventually won in Germany; with the continued community sponsorship and support we hope to win here, too. We refuse to take even the smallest step towards building the machinery of mandatory DNS restriction, and we will not abandon our obligation to the security, privacy, and integrity we have said we will deliver to users worldwide. We deeply regret having to step back from France and hope we will be able to return some day and offer the same unfiltered services that the rest of the world enjoys.

这是我们面临的第二次法律攻击，旨在试探 DNS 是否会被逐步腐蚀——我们坚守立场，最终在 德国胜诉；在社区持续的赞助和支持下，我们希望此次也能获胜。我们拒绝朝着建立强制 DNS 限制机制的方向迈出哪怕最小的一步，也不会放弃对全球用户所做的安全、隐私和完整性的承诺。我们对不得不退出法国深感遗憾，并希望有一天能够重返当地，为用户提供与世界其他地区相同的无过滤服务。

Legal battles like this drain time and resources away from building a better, safer internet. Your financial support is what keeps us in the fight—and keeps our services free and open for everyone. If you stand with us, please consider donating or becoming a sponsor today.

像这样的法律纠纷会耗尽时间和资源，使我们无法致力于建设一个更好、更安全的互联网。你的资金支持让我们能够继续战斗，并让服务对所有人保持免费和开放。如果你与我们站在一起，请考虑今天捐赠或成为赞助商。

item.content:encoded:
from: 2035 came early

tl;dr trynix.dev boots GUI programs now. Try solitaire, GL gears, xeyes, a voice, the weather over curl, or Firefox.

tl;dr trynix.dev 现在启动 GUI 程序。 尝试 solitaire, GL gears, xeyes, a voice, the weather over curl, 或 Firefox

I remember watching the talk The Birth & Death of JavaScript by Gary Bernhardt and falling in love with the whimsical yet dreadfully serious unfolding of the story of how JavaScript will come to dominate all software.

我记得观看了 The Birth & Death of JavaScript 由 Gary Bernhardt 并爱上了 JavaScript 将如何统治所有软件的故事的俏皮但令人敬畏的严肃展开。

Others have noted the inevitability of JavaScript’s dominance, so perhaps it was not surprising that Atwood’s Law holds true.

其他人已经指出 JavaScript 的主导地位不可避免，所以 Atwood’s Law 仍然成立，这或许并非出乎意料。

Atwood’s Law Any application that can be written in JavaScript, will eventually be written in JavaScript. — Jeff Atwood, 2009

Atwood 定律 任何能够用 JavaScript 编写的应用，最终都会被用 JavaScript 编写出来。 — Jeff Atwood, 2009

I highly recommend watching the talk if you have not already seen it, but the short and skinny is a lookback from 2035 and how JavaScript came to be the defacto language for all software.

如果你还没有观看过这场演讲，我强烈推荐你观看；简短概括是 2035 年的回顾以及 JavaScript 如何成为所有软件的事实上的编程语言。

In Bernhardt’s retelling of events, the date is worked back from 2035, however unsurprisingly, large language models have rapidly sped up the timeline. What was once perceived to be the end-state at 2035 has arrived years earlier and you can witness it unfolding at trynix.dev.

在 Bernhardt 对事件的复述中，日期是从 2035 年倒推出来的，但不出所料，大语言模型迅速加速了这一时间线。曾被视为 2035 年终态的情形已提前数年到来，你可以在 trynix.dev 见证它逐步展开。

JavaScript 战争 JavaScript 消失 trynix, Nov 2026 asm.js GIMP 在标签页中 METAL 十天内编写； 每个浏览器都运行它 2020 至 2025： 五年一事无成 没有人写它； 一切都运行在它上 Firefox 在 Linux 上， 在浏览器标签页中 C 和 C++ 编译到它 接近原生速度 桌面程序 为 web 编译 浏览器的 VM 成为操作系统 1995 2005 2015 2025 2035

One of the most impressive creations I’ve managed to build leveraging nixpkgs-multiverse is https://trynix.dev.

我利用 nixpkgs-multiverse 构建出的最令人印象深刻的成果之一是 https://trynix.dev。

It still baffles my mind that I can run any Nix package, over 300,000 distinct package versions, straight from my browser. Truly insane capability. I was however a little dismayed at the speed of the QEMU emulation in the browser. It was slow enough that the creation tipped more towards novelty than practicality.

这仍然令人费解，我竟然可以直接从我的浏览器中运行 任何 Nix 软件包，包含超过 300,000 个不同的软件包版本。这真是一种疯狂的能力。不过，对于我在浏览器中 QEMU 模拟的速度，我有点小失望。它慢到，创建过程更偏向新奇，而不是实用。

I woke on November 20th and saw Domen Kožar sharing a single message in our TacoSprint Discord channel: unkernel.dev

11 月 20 日醒来时，我看到 Domen Kožar 在我们的 TacoSprint Discord 频道里发了一条消息：unkernel.dev

It was the fast browser Linux experience I had sought to achieve, but with Nix.

我追求获得快速的 Linux 浏览器体验，但使用 Nix。

In an AI induced manic frenzy, I adopted the new engine along with a slough of long-wished features almost immediately.

在 AI 诱导的狂热中，我几乎立即采用了新引擎，并配上了许多向往已久的功能。

The proof is in the pudding: unkernel delivers remarkable speed improvements over qemu-wasm,1 especially on first runs where kernel work dominates. The new engine is able to deliver 2x to 32x faster performance depending on the workload.2

最终的证明来自实际结果： unkernel 相比 qemu-wasm，1，尤其是在首次运行时，此时内核工作占主导。

新引擎能够根据工作负载提供 2x 到 32x 的速度提升。2

JavaScript & WebAssembly nirvana.

JavaScript 和 WebAssembly nirvana。

Amazingly not only does the kernel boot quickly, it also enables networking, full-fledged graphical and audio experiences directly in the browser.

令人惊叹的是，不仅内核启动速度快，而且直接在浏览器中实现了网络连接、完整的图形和音频体验。

Windows. A program’s Wayland surfaces are composited in the page by wland, and they float over the terminal you started them from.

Windows. 程序的 Wayland surface 由 wland 合成到页面中，并且会浮现在你启动它们的终端上方。

GL. The VM includes a minimal Mesa build with only the virgl driver, compiled to WebAssembly, rendering through your browser’s WebGL2.

GL. VM 包含一个仅包含 virgl 驱动的极简 Mesa 构建，编译为 WebAssembly，并通过浏览器的 WebGL2 进行渲染。

Sound. The VM has an ALSA sound card, and can play audio through your browser.

声音。 VM 有一块 ALSA 声卡，并且能够通过你的浏览器播放音频。

Network. curl, git clone and pip install work. Each TCP connection goes over one WebSocket to a Wisp relay.3

网络。 curl, git clone 和 pip install 可工作。 Each TCP 连接通过单个 WebSocket 向 Wisp 中继发送。3

The best joke in Bernhardt’s talk is a browser running inside another browser: the Windows GIMP under Wine, in Chrome, in Firefox. Of course, I had to try it with trynix. 😈

Bernhardt 演讲中最精彩的梗是浏览器套浏览器：在 Firefox 里跑 Chrome，在 Chrome 里跑 Wine，在 Wine 里跑 Windows 版 GIMP。当然，我必须用 trynix 试一把。😈

吉普、 Wine、 X Windows、 CC、 asm.js、 Chrome、 Cacao、 Chrome、 Cacao、 Firefox、 trynix.dev、 Firefox、 Wayland、 Linux、 WebAssembly、 trynix、 Firefox、 Wayland、 Linux、 WebAssembly、 trynix、 Firefox，“伯纳特的 2035，绘制于 2014”和“trynix，2026 年11月”.

Here is Firefox in trynix, and it loading trynix.dev, and then loading Firefox again inside itself.4

这里是 Firefox in trynix，它正在加载 trynix.dev，随后又在自身内部再次加载 Firefox。4

Sit and bask in that insanity. That is Firefox, on Linux compiled to WebAssembly, in a Firefox tab, loading the site and then loading Firefox again inside itself. 🤯

坐下来，感受那份疯狂吧。那是 Firefox，在 Linux 编译为 WebAssembly 中，在一个 Firefox 标签页中，正在加载该站点，然后再次将 Firefox 加载到其自身之内。🤯

2035 came early.

2035 提前到来。

item.title: LLM代理为其母公司工作，而非为你
item.description: In the evenings after work, I will often sit out back on the porch and do some phone rotting. That usually takes the form of me just flipping through reels on Instagram, allowing the algorithm to take me where it may. I usually pair this with a healthy tumbler of rum or bourbon. I’m turning my brain off after work, and I’m just having a good time on the internet. The kids might call it dopamine maxxing? Hell, I don’t know. Who gives a shit about what those assholes would call it?
item.content:encoded:
from: LLM agents work for their parent companies, not for you

In the evenings after work, I will often sit out back on the porch and do some phone rotting. That usually takes the form of me just flipping through reels on Instagram, allowing the algorithm to take me where it may. I usually pair this with a healthy tumbler of rum or bourbon. I’m turning my brain off after work, and I’m just having a good time on the internet. The kids might call it dopamine maxxing? Hell, I don’t know. Who gives a shit about what those assholes would call it?

下班后的晚上，我常常坐在屋后的门廊上，来点“phone rotting”（刷手机摆烂）。通常就是翻 Instagram 上的 reels，让算法随便把我带到哪儿算哪儿。我一般还会配上一大杯朗姆酒或波本威士忌。下班后我就是把脑子关掉，在网上图个乐。年轻人也许会把这叫 dopamine maxxing？妈的，我哪知道。谁他妈在乎那些混蛋怎么叫它？

Anywho, I often encounter songs I really really like, and I would like to listen and discover more of please. Instagram makes it hard for me to connect with the band outside of their platform. I was trying to make this connection manually myself at first. I would just email myself a reel from my phone. Then when I’m back on the sofa and in the mood to track down new music, I’d open the reels and do my best to search on Bandcamp or YouTube or try to figure out if some of these musicians had a way to buy music from them. Very few do these days. They send you their Spotify link or send you to their TikTok page. I don’t want to do any of that. I’d like to trade US dollars in exchange for some music files I can download onto my computer, where I can listen as much as I like on any device I own thank you please. Retro maxxing.

总之，我经常遇到一些我真的真的超级喜欢的歌曲，很想去听并发现更多。Instagram 让我很难在平台之外和乐队建立联系。起初我试着自己手动建立这种联系。我只是从手机给自己发一条 reel。然后当我回到沙发上，有兴致去找新音乐时，我会打开 reels 并尽力在 Bandcamp 或 YouTube 上搜索，或者试图弄清楚这些音乐家中是否有人有办法让我从他们那里买音乐。如今很少有人这么做。他们会发给你他们的 Spotify 链接，或者把你引导到他们的 TikTok 页面。我不想做任何这些。我想用美元换取一些我可以下载到电脑上的音乐文件，这样我就可以在任何我拥有的设备上随意聆听，谢谢你，拜托。Retro maxxing。

So, I used Claude Code to build a skill that does this for me. It opens the Instagram reel and attempts to identify the artist and song. It then tries to determine if the artists have a Bandcamp page so I can purchase the songs I want, and if it finds one, it gives me the URL so I can click it to complete the trade I want. I want to buy music from artists who make music I like. That’s a fair and wholesome endeavor, I feel, but this recently stopped working.

所以，我用 Claude Code 构建了一个可为我完成此任务的技能。它会打开 Instagram Reel 并尝试识别音乐人和歌曲。然后，它会尝试判断这些音乐人是否有 Bandcamp 页面，以便我可以购买我想要的歌曲；如果找到，它会提供 URL，让我可以点击它来完成我想要的操作。我想从制作我喜欢音乐的创作者那里购买音乐。我觉得这是一项公平且美好的努力，但最近它停止工作了。

It turns out Bandcamp added a challenge on their search API page. Ah bummer. No worries, that was an unpublished workaround anyway. As I was mulling over this discovery, the robot went on to explain that it would not help me work around the challenge. cue Nick Young question marks

原来 Bandcamp 在他们的搜索 API 页面上加了个验证码挑战。哎呀，真扫兴。不过也没事，那本来就是个未公开的变通方案。正当我琢磨这事儿时，那机器人接着说它不会帮我绕过这个挑战。Nick Young 问号脸梗图出场

Well, that led me down a whole nother rabbit hole, which is turning into this post. There’s another branch of my skill that attempts to locate the same song from the Instagram reel on YouTube, and it’ll download the song to my computer if I ask.

嗯，这又让我掉进了另一个兔子洞，而这个坑正在变成眼前的这篇 post。我的技能里还有另一个分支，它会尝试在 YouTube 上找到 Instagram Reel 中的同一首歌，如果我开口要求，它还会把这首歌下载到我的电脑上。

So let me get this straight. The robot, which is my robot that I pay a pretty penny for, will not attempt to work around the challenge at Bandcamp so that I can more easily connect with bands to complete a sale, but it will download the YouTube song, which doesn’t send any money to the band or anyone???

所以让我理清一下。 我的机器人，我花了不少钱买的，它不会尝试在 Bandcamp 上规避这个挑战，以便我能更轻松地与乐队联系完成销售， 但它会下载 YouTube 上的歌曲，这首歌并没有向乐队或任何人发送任何金钱！？

This is the real danger of the frontier AI models. Not that it won’t help me hack Bandcamp1, but that this model doesn’t really work for us. Well, they do, but only insofar as Anthropic or OpenAI or whoever else allows them to. In this case, Anthropic is trying to ensure that people can’t use their models for evil. I’m not trying to do evil. I’m actually trying to do good! I want to buy something from a small artist on the internet. That’s basically the most wholesome thing a person can do on the internet!

这是前沿 AI 模型的真正危险所在。倒不是因为它拒绝帮我黑进 Bandcamp1，而是这类模型对我们来说根本不好用。好吧，它们确实能用，但仅限于 Anthropic、OpenAI 或其他提供商允许的范围内。在本例中，Anthropic 试图确保人们无法利用其模型作恶。我并非意图作恶，我其实是想行善！我想在网上从一位小艺术家手里买点东西。这基本上是一个人在互联网上能做的最纯良的事了！

Have no doubt, dear reader, these companies want to dominate. They want to capture the market. They want all the money. It’ll be the same march to enshittification that happened with Google. A bunch of nerds who built something cool sold out, and it turned into just another business that decided to remove its don’t be evil mantra.

毫无疑问，亲爱的读者，这些公司想要主导。它们想要占领市场。它们想要所有的钱。这将和 Google 一样，走向 enshittification。一群造出酷东西的极客卖身了，它变成了另一家决定移除其 don’t be evil 座右铭的普通企业。

Right now, I think the robots are providing real information to the best of their ability, but I think it’s only a matter of time until we must wonder if the answers they’re providing are real answers that the robot found, or if they’re weighted answers Anthropic put there because a company gave it enough money for product placement. I want to know the best robot vacuum according to old reddit or other trusted sources like Wirecutter, weighed and measured according to what I, and thus my robot agent, think are important requirements. I don’t want to know which robot vacuum parent multinational conglomerate has a large ad budget.

目前，我认为机器人正在以最好的能力提供真实信息，但我认为这只是时间问题，我们必须开始怀疑它们提供的答案是机器人实际找到的真实答案，还是因为 Anthropic 为了公司提供的足够资金进行产品置换而加权的答案。我想知道根据旧的 Reddit 或其他可信来源（如 Wirecutter）找出的最佳机器人吸尘器，衡量标准是我（以及因此我的机器人代理人）认为重要的要求。我不想知道哪个机器人吸尘器的母公司跨国集团拥有大量广告预算。

And it’s not just ads. If Anthropic can tell its model not to work around a challenge, then it can tell its model to do whatever the US government tells it to do, including not helping people download copyrighted music. It does that some now, but it’s easy to slip the noose on that. For now.

不只是广告。如果 Anthropic 可以让它的模型不绕过挑战，那么它可以让模型做美国政府指令的任何事，包括不帮助人们下载版权音乐。它现在已经这么做了，但在这条线上容易出错。 目前。

This is the reason I want a local model that runs in my homelab. My robot should work for me and have my best interests in mind, not the interests of US corporate copyright holders. I plan to study up on what “open models” even means. I’ve been thinking about these as the FOSS version of LLMs, but I think that doesn’t exactly map, as the biggest piece seems to be how the model was trained. The Chinese models are likely to refuse to answer questions about Taiwan, for example.

我之所以想要一个在家庭实验室运行的本地模型，正是出于这个原因。我的机器人应该为我服务，以我的最佳利益为重，而非美国企业版权持有者的利益。我打算深入研究一下“开放模型”到底意味着什么。我一直把它们当作 LLM 领域的 FOSS 版本，但我觉得这种对应并不完全准确，因为最关键的部分似乎在于模型是如何训练的。例如，中国模型很可能会拒绝回答关于台湾的问题。

On the existential threat or tool question, I’m firmly in the tool camp, and I really do not like artificial restrictions on my tools. I will do everything I reasonably can to remove those restrictions.

在 存在性威胁或工具 问题上， 我坚定地站在 工具 阵营， 真的不喜欢对我的工具的人为限制。 我会尽一切合理努力去消除这些限制。

收到。请提供需要翻译的英文原文。

Signal

Signal

Signal 是一个开源的 messaging protocol 提供 end-to-end encryption 的安全通信。它使用 Double Ratchet algorithm 支持多种 message types，包括 text, voice, 和 video。

  1. And to be clear, I’m not trying to work around Bandcamp’s challenge. I’m responding to the fact that Claude preemptively told me it wouldn’t help me do this. ↩︎ ↩︎

item.title: Ladybird 现已进入 Alpha 阶段
item.description:
Hello friends! Ladybird is now in alpha. You can download it for macOS and Linux.

朋友们好！Ladybird 现已进入 alpha 阶段。你可以在 macOS 和 Linux 上下载它。

I’ve been looking forward to writing this post for a long time.:^)

我早就想写这篇博文了。 :^)
item.content:encoded:
from: Ladybird is now in alpha

Hello friends! Ladybird is now in alpha. You can download it for macOS and Linux.

朋友们好！Ladybird 现已进入 alpha 阶段。你可以在 macOS 和 Linux 上下载它。

I’ve been looking forward to writing this post for a long time.:^)

我早就想写这篇博文了。 :^)

Ladybird is a browser with a new engine. The engine is our own, built from the ground up, and not a fork. The browser around it is modest, but functional.

Ladybird 是一款搭载新引擎的浏览器。引擎是我们自主研发的，从零开始构建，非分支。浏览器简洁但实用。

This is an alpha, so some websites won’t work, and it will crash sometimes. When that happens, tell us! You can report a broken site from inside the browser. After a crash, you can read the crash report and decide whether to send it. Our privacy policy has the details.

这是一个 alpha 版本，所以有些网站可能无法正常工作，有时会崩溃。当发生这种情况时，请告诉我们！你可以在浏览器内报告出现问题的站点。崩溃后，你可以阅读崩溃报告并决定是否发送。我们的 隐私政策 包含详细信息。

We want security nerds to hack it! A new browser gets hacked, over and over, and that’s part of the process, so we make no promises about security today. When you pwn us, please tell us how so we can harden Ladybird!

我们希望安全爱好者能攻破它！一款新的浏览器会被攻破，一次又一次，而这只是流程的一部分，所以我们今天无法对安全性做出承诺。当你攻破我们时，请告诉我们如何做，这样我们就能加固 Ladybird！

The alpha is a rolling channel, and we’ll be pushing out automatic updates regularly. This is the part I’m most excited about. Ladybird improves quickly, and until now you had to build it from source to see that.

alpha 是一个滚动发布渠道，我们会定期推送自动更新。这是我最期待的部分。Ladybird 进步飞快，而在此之前，你必须从源码自行构建才能看到这些改进。

If you build websites, try yours in Ladybird and tell us what breaks. It supports WebDriver for automated testing, as well as the Firefox DevTools protocol.

如果你构建网站，请在 Ladybird 中试试你的网站，并告诉我们哪里出了问题。它支持用于自动化测试的 WebDriver，以及 Firefox DevTools 协议。

Thank you to our sponsors and donors, and to everyone who has tested, reported bugs, and written code over the years. There’s still a mountain of work ahead of us, but I’m very happy that you can finally try Ladybird for yourself!

感谢 我们的赞助商 和捐赠者，并感谢过去多年测试、报告Bug并编写代码的每一位。我们面前仍有大量工作要做，但我非常高兴你终于可以亲自试用Ladybird了！
